about: Water names in Utah's records that data/receiving-waters-national.json does not hold for UT: the water a sewage report's title names (DEQ's Environmental Incidents layer), the water each advisory site of DWQ's Recreational Waters Map lies on, and EPA's receiving water on Utah's eRule reports; one row per name and county (the county of the record's point, else the county it gives), with the number of reports, how many are open now, up to five of their points ([lat, lon], 0.001 degree), their towns and sources, so the names pass builds each name where the reports are (Utah has a Gordon Creek in Morgan County and another in Carbon County). Records naming no water and texts that name a drain or outfall are left out (by_reason). Written by scripts/ut_report_water_names.py.
